changeSet.author: catxi
changeSet.comment: Keep chat text in chat history and replace duplicated text in notification records
changeSet.sql: UPDATE fcm_outbox SET payload = JSON_SET(payload, '$.body', '새로운 채팅 메시지가 도착했습니다') WHERE event_type = 'CHAT_MESSAGE' AND JSON_VALID(payload)
UPDATE fcm_dead_letter SET payload = JSON_SET(payload, '$.body', '새로운 채팅 메시지가 도착했습니다') WHERE JSON_VALID(payload) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.type')) = 'CHAT_MESSAGE'
